comparison.objective: Press a power cord into a curved cable channel; the candidate adjusts and locks a gripper stop.
comparison.physical_skill: Progressive deformable-cord routing and seating along a curved groove, not concentric threaded countertorque.
comparison.success_condition: Cord must remain seated along the required channel length without damage or escape; candidate tests mechanical calibration.
comparison.reason: Both versions test cable routing, a different contact sequence and outcome.
